welcome_message: Thank you for calling Acme Solutions. Please listen carefully to the following options.

main.prompt: For office hours and location, press 1. For sales inquiries, press 2. For technical support, press 3. To leave a general voicemail, press 4. To repeat this menu, press 9.

1.say: Our offices are located at 100 Innovation Way, Suite 400. We are open Monday through Friday from 9 AM to 5 PM Eastern Time. Thank you for calling!

4.say: Please leave your name, phone number, and a brief message after the beep. Press pound when you are finished.

sales.prompt: You have reached Sales. Press 1 to request a product demo callback. Press 2 to hear pricing tiers. Press 0 to return to the main menu.

1.say: Please leave your company name and contact number for a sales demo. An account representative will call you back within one business day.

2.say: Our Starter plan begins at $29 per month, and our Enterprise plan begins at $199 per month. Visit our website for detailed feature comparisons. Goodbye!

support.prompt: You have reached Technical Support. Press 1 to check current system operational status. Press 2 to log an urgent support ticket. Press 0 to return to the main menu.

1.say: All servers and cloud services are currently operating normally at 100 percent uptime. Goodbye!

2.say: Please describe your technical issue and provide your account email address. A technician will be alerted immediately.
